Proposition
[product rule characterization]

↗ def:dc-ch2-3-1 ↗ prop:dc-ch2-2-6 ↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-2-coord

1. ch2:3.2A connection $\nabla $ is compatible with the metric if and only if, for all vector fields $V,W$ along every differentiable curve $c\colon I\to M$, \[ \frac{d}{dt}\langle V,W\rangle =\left\langle \frac{DV}{dt},W\right\rangle +\left\langle V,\frac{DW}{dt}\right\rangle , \qquad t\in I.\tag {3} \]
Proof

\sketch Formula (3) immediately makes inner products of parallel fields constant. Conversely, parallel-transport an orthonormal basis at one point along $c$; compatibility keeps it orthonormal. Expanding $V=\sum _iv^iP_i$ and $W=\sum _iw^iP_i$ in this parallel frame reduces (3) to the ordinary product rule for $\sum _iv^iw^i$.

□
